shortDescription: Manage host group on PowerStore Storage System

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: host_connectivity
options.description: Connectivity type for host group. If any of metro connectivity options specified, a metro host group must exists in both cluster provide connectivity to a metro volume from both cluster.

options.name: host_state
options.description: Define whether the hosts should be present or absent in host group. Value C(present-in-group) - indicates that the hosts should exist on the host group. Value C(absent-in-group) - indicates that the hosts should not exist on the host group. Required when creating a host group with hosts or adding/removing hosts from existing host group.

options.name: hostgroup_id
options.description: The 36-character long host group id, automatically generated when a host group is created. Use either I(hostgroup_id) or I(hostgroup_name) for modify and delete tasks. The I(hostgroup_id) cannot be used while creating host group, as it is generated by the array after creation of host group.

options.name: hostgroup_name
options.description: The host group name. This value must contain 128 or fewer printable Unicode characters. Creation of an empty host group is not allowed. Required when creating a host group. Use either I(hostgroup_id) or I(hostgroup_name) for modify and delete tasks.

options.name: hosts
options.description: List of hosts to be added or removed from the host group. Subordinate hosts in a host group can only be of one type, either FC or iSCSI. Required when creating a host group. To represent host, both name or ID can be used interchangeably. The module will detect both.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new name for host group renaming function. This value must contain 128 or fewer printable Unicode characters.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the host group should exist or not. Value C(present) - indicates that the host group should exist on the system. Value C(absent) - indicates that the host group should not exist on the system. Deletion of a host group results in deletion of the containing hosts as well. Remove hosts from the host group first to retain them.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
